title: All appropriate inquiries: what the Phase I must cover and how long it lasts
rule: To claim CERCLA's innocent landowner, contiguous owner or bona fide prospective purchaser protection, a buyer conducts all appropriate inquiries before taking title: an environmental professional's inquiry plus the buyer's own cleanup-lien search, specialized knowledge and check of price against uncontaminated value. ASTM E1527-21, or E2247-23 for forestland or rural property, is a recognized way to comply. The inquiry must fall within one year before acquisition, and the interviews, lien search, records review, site visit and declaration within 180 days.
changeWatch: EPA amendments to Part 312 or to the ASTM standards it recognizes; E1527-13 stopped qualifying on February 13, 2024 and E2247-16 on June 24, 2025.
